name: Knock-Knock
source:
You're off duty, it's Halloween. The streets are full of laughter and masks. Children go door to door – but not every knock is innocent.

[From [url=https://fractalbot.itch.io/knock-knock]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你下班了，今天是万圣节。街道上充满了欢笑和面具。孩子们挨家挨户地挨家挨户地敲门，但并非每一次敲门都是无辜的。

[来自[url=https://fractalbot.itch.io/knock-knock]Itch.io[/url]]
